message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Defendant Luo (骆某) forged four copies of car purchase invoices in the name of a convicted person (焦某) and used them as credit proof to obtain a loan of 300,000 yuan from a rural commercial bank. He repaid 20,000 yuan and transferred 280,000 yuan (i.e., loan rollover). Then the loan defaulted, causing direct economic loss of 280,000 yuan to the bank.

Thus the crime is loan fraud (贷款诈骗). In the list, there is a label "贷款诈骗". Indeed earlier examples: second example (刘2某) was labeled "贷款诈骗". So answer: [罪名]贷款诈骗<eoa>.

There's also "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章". But the invoice is a commercial document, not necessarily a state document. The charge used in example for loan fraud includes forging documents as part of the fraud. The label used is "贷款诈骗". So we output that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]贷款诈骗<eoa>
